skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of project management including project lifecycle, organizational models, planning processes, and project progress management.
Understand resource allocation techniques including workload scheduling, prioritization principles, and multi-resource distribution for projects.
Understand cost estimation methods including budgeting, cost calculation, and trade-offs between time and cost.
Understand quality management concepts including quality costs, tools, and the importance of quality management in projects.
Understand risk management techniques including identification, analysis, and response strategies for project risks.
Understand time management techniques including work network diagrams, PERT, and Gantt charts for project scheduling.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve specific problems in project management scenarios.
Develop self-learning abilities to independently study and adapt to globalized and Industry 4.0 contexts.
Develop teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with peers in group projects.
Understand legal regulations and adhere to all school rules and policies.
